everyone\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGreetings\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am Dr.Afeefa farzana,Intern from INDIA\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI want to present a compilation of cases that I came across during my journey as a MBBS student during my postings\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDisclaimer\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\" style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EThis is an online e log book to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his \/ her \/ guardians signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\" style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan\u003Ecomment box is welcome.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EI joined MBBS in 2018 during our first proff we didn't have much exposure clinical side as we were focused on understanding physiology,anatomy,biochemistry\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003EIn the year 2019 during our 3 semester first day of our clinical postings in the Department of General medicine our HOD have enlightened us that medicine is compilation of anatomy, physiology,biochemistry, pharmacology and pathology.rather than thinking medicine as a subject we started applying our knowledge from the pre and para clinical subjects in understanding the disease process and the patient suffering\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003EThe very first patient I saw was a case of 60 year old male c\/o bradykinesia,rigidity, tremors and was diagnosed as parkinsonism I was very much surprised to corelate our theoretical knowledge\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003EThere comes the reign of covid 19 we all were forced to sit at homes and were distanced from clinical learning\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003EThen our seniors started making blogs of patients which helped us to understand what patient is going through\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003EAll thanks to our HOD for starting the idea of making blogs\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003ETaking the detailed history of patietnts ,Sequence of events, how the disease has changed the life style of an individual have helped us to understand the severity and suffering of the patient\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003EI would like to share a case which I presented for my pre finals\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EThis is a case of 19 year old who is intermediate second year student came to general medicine OPD with chief complaints of\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EFever since 3 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003ELower back ache since 3 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EGeneralized weakness since 3 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 10 days back then he developed high grade fever which was continuous ,no diurnal variation which got relieved on medication given by local RMP [some IV medication was given for 1 day and oral medication for 3 days].\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003ENow again since 3 days he had high grade fever which was continuous not associated with chills and rigor ,no diurnal variation\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EHe had one episode of vomiting today which was non projectile contained food particles\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EHe also complained of low back ache since 3 days which is insidious in onset ,gradually progressive, and is persistent and pain increased during inspiration and no relieving factors.[he was unable to describe the character of pain]\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EHe also complained of abdominal pain which is insidious in onset persistent not associated with nausea and vomiting\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EHe also complained of generalized weakness since 3 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003ENo history of burning micturition, increased frequency of urine ,difficulty to pass urine ,nocturnal eneursis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003ENo history of loose stools\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/afeefafarzanarollno9.blogspot.com\/2022\/11\/19-year-old-male-with-fever-and-lower.html\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003EDuring our discussion the question which was left un answered was why is the patient who is having dengue fever should have low back ache ?is it because of serositis?? If it was due to pyelonephritis why only Unilateral why not bilateral?\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003EHere is an other case\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EThis is a case of 38 year old male came to gm OPD with chief complaints of pain abdomen and retrosternal burning sensation\u0026nbsp; since 7\u0026nbsp; years\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 15 years ago then he developed\u0026nbsp; abdominal pain which is diffuse,squeezing type of pain,insidious in onset,intermittent associated with alternating constipation and\u0026nbsp; loose stools and generalised weakness since 15 years\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EHistory of blood passed in stools occasionally since 15 years\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EPatient also gives complaints of retrosternal\u0026nbsp; burning sensation associated with nausea since 15 years\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EHistory of belching present\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EHistory of fever on and off\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EHistory of significant weight loss\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003ENo history of vomitings\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/afeefafarzanarollno9.blogspot.com\/2023\/05\/38-years-male-pain-abdomen-under.html\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003EHis pain abdomen is still under evaluation since 7 years.all necessary investigations were done but nothing could evaluate his pain abdomen\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003EIs it ulcerative colitis ?? For how long is the patient going to have pain abdomen??is there any way we could help him out??\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EHere is an interesting case\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/afeefafarzanarollno9.blogspot.com\/2023\/03\/1801006002-long-case.html\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003EWas it a TIA? sans-serif;\"\u003EThis patient had taught me the entire chapter of stroke ,CNS examination\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cbr
